title: FloatCMS
description: Open source headless CMS platform engineered to be an entirely customizable API to drive frontend websites.
content:
# Summary


[Open source headless CMS platform](https://github.com/ukiyodigital/float) engineered to be an entirely customizable API to drive frontend websites. Design and collaboration were heavily accompanied by [Cory](https://www.linkedin.com/in/findingcory/).


## Tools Used


Django Rest Framework, GraphQL, React, Material UI, Apollo


# Why


I had a lot of experience building out GitHub pages hosted websites for a few years after college. Unfortunately, using CMS options were either too expensive, not super configurable or very platform specific. I wanted something like a Headless CMS without having to pay for a subscription per user account.
